problems.title: Every shopkeeper knows these headaches. We fixed them.
problems.sub: Seven real problems that eat into your time and profits every day, and the app handles them for you.

cards.title: Keep your shop and its secrets safe
cards.body: The shop serial works only on the shop owner's phone. No sales rep can take over the shop's account or see purchase prices and profits.

cards.title: Add your team in one tap
cards.body: No technical steps. You create a 6-digit join code from a panel at the bottom of the screen, copy it in one tap, and the manager's or sales rep's phone is activated straight away with the role you chose.

cards.title: Instant control over your shop devices
cards.body: From your phone, remove any device in a second if the phone is lost or someone leaves, and change anyone's role with a new join code.

cards.title: Stop losing profit
cards.body: When you buy the same item at different prices during the month, you end up selling at an old price and losing money. The app works out the average cost by itself, down to the piaster, with every supplier invoice, so you know your real cost and price correctly.

cards.title: No more messy paper invoices
cards.body: Instead of spending hours after a long day typing supplier invoices item by item, take a quick photo or use a PDF file, and the app reads every line in seconds.

cards.title: Accurate credit and debt accounts
cards.body: Close tracking of what customers and suppliers owe, receipt and payment vouchers, and a clear dated account statement. Customers are never merged behind your back, so people's debts never get mixed up.

cards.title: Sharing work with your team
cards.body: Sales rep out in the street with no internet? At the end of the day they send you their work in a file over WhatsApp or any other app, or it updates online by itself if you turn that on. And the file that goes to a sales rep never contains costs or profits.

features.title: Everything your shop needs, on your phone
features.sub: Sales, purchases, stock, debts, and AI that works with you all day without slowing you down.

cards.title: Fast point of sale for sales reps
cards.body: As soon as a sales rep opens the app, the sales screen is right there. They pick the customer, add items with a few quick taps, and choose cash, credit or part payment. After saving, they send the customer a PDF invoice over WhatsApp, even without internet.

cards.title: Read supplier invoices from a photo
cards.body: Take a photo of the paper invoice (or several photos if it's long, or a PDF) and the app pulls out the items, quantities and purchase prices in seconds. It also spots free bonus items by itself and records them at zero cost.

cards.title: Average cost to the piaster
cards.body: The average cost of every item is worked out automatically, down to the piaster, with every new purchase invoice, so you know your real cost and price correctly.

cards.title: Selling below zero stock
cards.body: Sales won't stop just because an item isn't in stock yet. The app lets you sell, and the quantities correct themselves once you record the purchase invoice.

cards.title: Merge duplicate items
cards.body: If the same item was added under two different names, merge them with one tap to combine the stock, fix the cost, and teach invoice reading the right name.

cards.title: Backup and restore
cards.body: A full copy of the shop's data and accounts with one tap from Settings. Only the shop owner can restore, so the accounts stay safe.

cards.title: Snap without waiting
cards.body: Photograph one invoice after another, and each one is saved in a second. The "Invoices being read" list shows where each invoice is until it's ready for review.

cards.title: Deleted the app? Get back in by yourself
cards.body: If the shop owner deletes the app and installs it again on the same phone, they type the shop serial and are back in straight away, without calling support.

cards.title: Overpayments are recorded automatically
cards.body: If a customer pays more than the invoice, the extra is recorded automatically as a receipt voucher on their account, and the save message tells you so.

cards.title: Accurate sales rep profits
cards.body: The cost of each item on a sales rep's invoices comes from the shop owner's average cost at the time the work is received, so profits on sales reps' sales come out right.

how.title: Four steps, and your shop is up and running
how.sub: From activation to your first invoice in minutes, with no complicated technical steps.

steps.title: Activate your shop serial
steps.body: Open the app on your phone, type the shop serial, and tap "Activate". Your phone is registered as the shop owner, and the serial can't be activated on any other phone.

steps.title: Create a join code for your team
steps.body: In Settings, open "Shop devices", tap "Add device", choose manager or sales rep, and copy the 6-digit code. They type it in and they're ready to go.

steps.title: Photograph supplier invoices
steps.body: With every new delivery, one photo with the camera and the app records the items, quantities and prices, and updates the stock and average cost.

steps.title: Sell, collect and send in the work
steps.body: Sales reps sell and collect payments from the point of sale, and at the end of the day they send their work in a file over WhatsApp or any other app, or it updates online by itself.

exchange.title: In the street with a file over WhatsApp, or online in the background
exchange.sub: Two ways that work together, made for markets and areas where the signal is weak or gone.

file.title: Update by file
points: At the end of the day, the sales rep taps one button: "Send today's work to the shop owner".
The app makes a locked file with only the sales invoices, collected payments and new customers, with no costs or profits.
The sales rep sends the file to the shop owner over WhatsApp or any other app.
The shop owner taps "Receive file": the app checks that the file really came from the sales rep's phone, adds everything to the accounts, and never takes in the same file twice.

online.title: Online update (optional)
points: Runs by itself in the background as soon as there's internet.
Uploads invoices, collected payments and stock movements in batches.
If you want the app to work only on your phone, turn it off in Settings, and selling, stock counts and invoice reading keep working.

items.q: Does the app really work without internet?
items.a: Yes. Selling, collecting payments, counting stock, and making and sharing invoices as PDF all work with the internet off. If online update is on, it carries on by itself once the connection is back.
Only 3 things: activating a phone for the first time, reading supplier invoices from a photo, and online update if you turn it on. Everything else works without internet.

items.q: Do I have to pay anything for invoice reading?
items.a: No. Invoice reading runs on an "invoice reading key", a free key from Google that you create yourself from Settings in 3 steps: open the key page, copy the key, and paste it into the app. And if you need help, we're here.

items.q: What if a sales rep's phone is lost or stolen?
items.a: In Settings, open "Shop devices" and tap the remove mark next to the device. Straight away the app on that phone goes back to the activation screen and can't open the shop's data.

items.q: Can a sales rep see purchase prices or my profits?
items.a: No. A sales rep never sees purchase prices, costs, suppliers or profits, and can't change stock quantities by hand. Even the files they send or receive contain no costs or profits.

items.q: How long is a join code valid?
items.a: The 6-digit join code is valid for only 15 minutes, for security, and can be used once. As soon as the manager or sales rep types it in, their phone is activated with the role you chose, with no extra password.

items.q: What happens when my plan ends?
items.a: Your data stays saved on your phone and on each team member's phone according to their role, and if online update is on it's saved online too. When you renew, you carry on from where you left off.

items.q: Can I turn off online update?
items.a: Yes. Turn it off from the "Online data update (optional)" card in Settings, and the app works only on your phone, while selling, stock counts and invoice reading keep working. You can also make a full backup with one tap at any time.
